profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Consultant, Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Migrated and consolidated three legacy on-prem VB.NET applications into a single unified solution hosted in Azure, maintaining existing functionality while refactoring the codebases into a consistent architecture.
- Leveraged GitHub Copilot to help rewrite the application's reporting layer from scratch in SSRS, replacing legacy Crystal Reports.
- Developed a new license request feature, implementing a form workflow that triggered automated email notifications to the team.
- Restored and configured email functionality with the Azure-hosted environment and integrated Azure Blob Storage.

positions.title: Senior Analyst, Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project 1:
- Migrated multiple on-prem applications to Azure, implementing robust CI/CD pipelines for streamlined deployments and provisioning infrastructure with Terraform.
- Enhanced backend functionality by integrating Azure Key Vault for secure secrets management and Azure Blob Storage for handling file uploads.
- Resolved a critical sign-in issue related to JWTs and cookies.
- Identified and remediated a major security vulnerability.

Project 2:
- Migrated IBM Rational Team Concert (RTC) and IBM Rational Quality Manager (RQM) artifacts to Azure DevOps using Python.
- Built migration scripts to map RTC and RQM data models to Azure DevOps structures.
- Integrated with Azure DevOps REST APIs to create, update, and synchronize work and test items while maintaining data integrity across systems.

positions.title: Analyst, Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Engineered a full-stack web application with Angular and NgRx/RxJS for a responsive frontend, integrating a backend using C# with ASP.NET, and optimized data handling workflows with SQL Server Management Studio.
- Designed and implemented a retry mechanism for server errors using exponential backoff and jitter.
- Implemented automatic logout due to inactivity, while clearing all personal identifying information in the process.
- Developed a configuration service to alter environment variables and system codes on the fly in response to urgent needs.
- Developed and maintained Azure DevOps pipelines to allow for CI/CD of the web app and its microservices.
- Managed application data using SQL through SQL Server Management Studio.
- Partnered with UX, QA, and PM teams in Agile sprints to deliver features on time and improve customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Saved $70,000 annually by automating weekly sales reports using Python and Power BI, freeing 20 hours weekly across analysts and executives through centralizing insights.
- Revamped deployment processes with Azure DevOps pipelines, cutting manual eﬀort by 80% during release cycles.
positions.insights: Microsoft Power BI, Git and +9 skills
